blocks.x: The engineering substrate, as deployed in current programs:

items: Snowflake As The Governed Serving Layer
One governed copy for serving, with role-based access your audit team can walk.
Dynamic Masking And Row Policies
Masking applied at query time by policy — the same table answers differently by role, on purpose.
Snowpark
In-warehouse transformation for teams that want their logic where the data already is.
Streams And Tasks
Snowflake-native pipelines for teams that live in the warehouse — fewer moving parts, same discipline.
Cost-Per-Query Telemetry
Every query carries its price tag, visible to the team that wrote it.
Unity Catalog governance
A single governance plane over tables, models and notebooks — access your auditors can replay.
streaming ingest
Events land in seconds, not overnight batches — the precondition for decisions that happen in the moment.
freshness SLOs
Data age treated like uptime — a budget, an owner and an alert when it slips.
cost-aware clustering
Workloads land on the cheapest compute that still meets the latency budget.

blocks.x: The joint pattern for Snowflake Alliance: our pod does the build, your named owners hold the gates, and the evidence is generated in systems your teams already operate.
Artifacts, not anecdotes — at the first-quarter close your team holds:

items: Joint architecture pack
The target architecture drawn against your estate, with interfaces and owners made explicit.
Certified delivery pod
A named team with the clearances your estate requires — the same people from diagnosis to handover.
Support map
Who answers when something breaks — named roles, response expectations and the escalation path.
